# Data Analysis

## Loading of the libraries

We are using tidyverse framework to rearrange and analysis the data. 

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(forcats)

library("readxl") # read excel files
library(WriteXLS) # uses Perl and not Java - Java has a licence issue and should not be used at Empa 
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
tidyverse_conflicts()
```

## Input file nmae

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
filename15 <- "Data/15_VehicleComonentMaterialElementDefinitions.xlsx"       # Material definitions according to international standards

```

## Output file name

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
filename34 <- "Data/34_MaterialElementComponentComposition.xlsx"       # This is the output file specifying the material element composition of different alloys used in vehicle production
```

## Get the material composition for the different alloys and their specified (defined) mixtures

## Go through the different alloys and calculate the mean material composition

### AlSiCu

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

materialsAlCastAlloys2Low <- materialsAlCastAlloys2Low %>% add_column(limits = "low")
materialsAlCastAlloys2High <- materialsAlCastAlloys2High %>% add_column(limits = "high")

materialsAlCastAlloys2 <- bind_rows(materialsAlCastAlloys2Low, materialsAlCastAlloys2High)
# the following equation might need adjustment, if elements are deleted or other elements are added -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
materialsAlCastAlloys2 <- materialsAlCastAlloys2 %>% mutate(Al = 100 - Si - Fe - Cu - Mn - Mg - Cr - Ni - Zn - Mo - Zr - Pb - Sn - Ti - Sr - otherOrUndefinedElements - otherOrUndefinedElements_)
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

materialsAlCastAlloys2_long <- materialsAlCastAlloys2 %>% pivot_longer(cols = !c(AlloyGroup, Numerisch, limits), names_to = "Element", values_to = "Content")
materialsAlCastAlloys2_long <- materialsAlCastAlloys2_long %>% relocate(limits, .after = last_col())

materialsAlCastAlloys2_long_mean <- materialsAlCastAlloys2_long %>% group_by(AlloyGroup, Numerisch, Element) %>% summarise(Content = mean(Content), limits = "mean")
materialsAlCastAlloys2_long <- bind_rows(materialsAlCastAlloys2_long, materialsAlCastAlloys2_long_mean)

materialsAlCastAlloys2_means <- materialsAlCastAlloys2_long %>% group_by(Element, limits) %>% summarise(mean_values = mean(Content))
materialsAlCastAlloys2_means <- materialsAlCastAlloys2_means %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Element, values_from = mean_values)

materialsAlCastAlloys2 <- materialsAlCastAlloys2_long %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Element, values_from = Content)
materialsAlCastAlloys2   # 1

g <- ggplot(materialsAlCastAlloys2_long, mapping = aes(x = Element, y = Content)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle("Material composition - Cast Aluminum") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,100), name = "content (%)") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

plot(g)

g <- ggplot(materialsAlCastAlloys2_long, mapping = aes(x = Element, y = Content)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle("Material composition - Cast Aluminum") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 20), name = "content (%)") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16)) +
      theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12),
      axis.title=element_text(size=14,face="bold"))

plot(g)

ggsave("CompositionMaterials/CastAluminium2.png")

# Determine the composition

for (i in 1:nrow(AlSiCuDefinition)) {
  temp <- materialsAlCastAlloys2 %>% filter(Numerisch == AlSiCuDefinition$Alloys[i])
  temp_mean <- temp %>% filter(limits == "mean")
  temp_sum <- temp_mean %>% select(!c(Numerisch, limits)) %>% mutate(Si = Si * AlSiCuDefinition$Fraction[i], Fe = Fe * AlSiCuDefinition$Fraction[i],  Cu = Cu * AlSiCuDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                            Mn = Mn * AlSiCuDefinition$Fraction[i], Mg = Mg * AlSiCuDefinition$Fraction[i], Cr = Cr * AlSiCuDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                            Ni = Ni * AlSiCuDefinition$Fraction[i], Zn = Zn * AlSiCuDefinition$Fraction[i], Mo = Mo * AlSiCuDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                            Zr = Zr * AlSiCuDefinition$Fraction[i], Pb = Pb * AlSiCuDefinition$Fraction[i], Sn = Sn * AlSiCuDefinition$Fraction[i], 
                                                            Ti = Ti * AlSiCuDefinition$Fraction[i], Sr = Sr * AlSiCuDefinition$Fraction[i], otherOrUndefinedElements = otherOrUndefinedElements * AlSiCuDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                            otherOrUndefinedElements_ = otherOrUndefinedElements_ * AlSiCuDefinition$Fraction[i], Al = Al * AlSiCuDefinition$Fraction[i]
                                                            )
  
  if (i == 1) {
    materialAlSiCucompositionSum <- temp_sum
    materialAlSiCucompositionMaximas <- temp
  }
  else {
    materialAlSiCucompositionSum <- bind_rows(materialAlSiCucompositionSum, temp_sum)
    materialAlSiCucompositionMaximas <- bind_rows(materialAlSiCucompositionMaximas, temp)
  }
}
materialAlSiCucompositionSum  # 2
materialAlSiCucompositionMaximas  # 3
# the following equation might need adjustment, if elements are deleted or other elements are added -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
materialAlSiCucompositionSum <- materialAlSiCucompositionSum %>% summarise(Si = sum(Si), Fe = sum(Fe), Cu = sum(Cu), Mn = sum(Mn), Mg = sum(Mg), Cr = sum(Cr), Ni = sum(Ni), Zn = sum(Zn), 
                                                                             Zn = sum(Zn), Mo = sum(Mo), Zr = sum(Zr), Pb = sum(Pb), Sn = sum(Sn), Ti = sum(Ti), Sr = sum(Sr), otherOrUndefinedElements = sum(otherOrUndefinedElements),
                                                                             otherOrUndefinedElements_ = sum(otherOrUndefinedElements_), Al = sum(Al))
materialAlSiCucompositionSum 
materialAlSiCucompositionMax <- materialAlSiCucompositionMaximas %>% summarise(Si = max(Si), Fe = max(Fe), Cu = max(Cu), Mn = max(Mn), Mg = max(Mg), Cr = max(Cr), Ni = max(Ni), Zn = max(Zn), 
                                                                             Zn = max(Zn), Mo = max(Mo), Zr = max(Zr), Pb = max(Pb), Sn = max(Sn), Ti = max(Ti), Sr = max(Sr), otherOrUndefinedElements = max(otherOrUndefinedElements),
                                                                             otherOrUndefinedElements_ = max(otherOrUndefinedElements_), Al = max(Al))
materialAlSiCucompositionMin <- materialAlSiCucompositionMaximas %>% summarise(Si = min(Si), Fe = min(Fe), Cu = min(Cu), Mn = min(Mn), Mg = min(Mg), Cr = min(Cr), Ni = min(Ni), Zn = min(Zn), 
                                                                             Zn = min(Zn), Mo = min(Mo), Zr = min(Zr), Pb = min(Pb), Sn = min(Sn), Ti = min(Ti), Sr = min(Sr), otherOrUndefinedElements = min(otherOrUndefinedElements),
                                                                             otherOrUndefinedElements_ = min(otherOrUndefinedElements_), Al = min(Al))
# Should the Min and Max be changed for the main Element Aluminium
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
materialAlSiCucompositionSum <- materialAlSiCucompositionSum %>% add_column(limits = "mean")
materialAlSiCucompositionMax <- materialAlSiCucompositionMax %>% add_column(limits = "max")
materialAlSiCucompositionMin <- materialAlSiCucompositionMin %>% add_column(limits = "min")

materialAlSiCucomposition <- bind_rows(materialAlSiCucompositionSum, materialAlSiCucompositionMax)
materialAlSiCucomposition <- bind_rows(materialAlSiCucomposition, materialAlSiCucompositionMin)
materialAlSiCucomposition # 5

materialAlSiCucomposition_long <- materialAlSiCucomposition %>% pivot_longer(cols = !c(limits), names_to = "Element", values_to = "Content")

# Step 1: Extract rows where 'column_name' is 0
zero_entries_df <- materialAlSiCucomposition_long %>% filter(Content == 0 & limits == "mean")
zero_entries_df

# Step 2: Filter out these entries from the original dataframe
materialAlSiCucomposition_long <- materialAlSiCucomposition_long %>% filter(!(materialAlSiCucomposition_long$Element) %in% (zero_entries_df$Element))

materialAlSiCucomposition <- materialAlSiCucomposition_long

materialAlSiCucomposition_long <- materialAlSiCucomposition_long %>%
  mutate(
    Element = ifelse(Element == "otherOrUndefinedElements", "other1", Element),  # Replace "elvHEV" with "HEV"
    Element = ifelse(Element == "otherOrUndefinedElements_", "other2", Element)
  )

g <- ggplot(materialAlSiCucomposition_long, mapping = aes(x = Element, y = Content)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle("Material composition - AlSiCu") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,100), name = "content (%)") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

plot(g)

g <- ggplot(materialAlSiCucomposition_long, mapping = aes(x = Element, y = Content)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle("Material composition - AlSiCu") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 15), name = "content (%)") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16)) +
      theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12),
      axis.title=element_text(size=14,face="bold"))

plot(g)

ggsave("CompositionMaterials/AlSiCuVehicle.png")


```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
materialsAlWrought1000s_long <- bind_rows(materialsAlWrought1000s_long, materialsAlWrought1000s_long_mean)
materialsAlWrought1000s_long

materialsAlWrought1000s_means <- materialsAlWrought1000s_long %>% group_by(Element, limits) %>% summarise(mean_values = mean(Content))
materialsAlWrought1000s_means <- materialsAlWrought1000s_means %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Element, values_from = mean_values)
```

### Wrought Aluminium - 3000 series

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

materialsAlWrought3000sHigh <- materialsAlWrought3000sHigh %>% add_column(limits = "high")
```

### Wrought aluminium alloys used for extruding aluminium in car industry

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

for (i in 1:nrow(Al_5xxxAlDefinition)) {
  temp <- materialAlWrought %>% filter(Numerisch == Al_5xxxAlDefinition$Alloys[i])
  temp_mean <- temp %>% filter(limits == "mean")
  temp_sum <- temp_mean %>% select(!c(Numerisch, limits)) %>% mutate(Si = Si * Al_5xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Fe = Fe * Al_5xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Cu = Cu * Al_5xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                                Mn = Mn * Al_5xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Mg = Mg * Al_5xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Cr = Cr * Al_5xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                                Ni = Ni * Al_5xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Zn = Zn * Al_5xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Ti = Ti * Al_5xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                                Ga = Ga * Al_5xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], V = V * Al_5xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], otherOrUndefinedElements = otherOrUndefinedElements * Al_5xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                                otherOrUndefinedElements_ = otherOrUndefinedElements_ * Al_5xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Al = Al * Al_5xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i]
                                                                )
 
  if (i == 1) {
    materialAl_5xxxcompositionSum <- temp_sum
    materialAl_5xxxcompositionMaximas <- temp
  }
  else {
    materialAl_5xxxcompositionSum <- bind_rows(materialAl_5xxxcompositionSum, temp_sum)
    materialAl_5xxxcompositionMaximas <- bind_rows(materialAl_5xxxcompositionMaximas, temp)
  }
}
materialAl_5xxxcompositionSum
materialAl_5xxxcompositionMaximas

# the following equation might need adjustment, if elements are deleted or other elements are added -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
materialAl_5xxxcompositionSum <- materialAl_5xxxcompositionSum %>% summarise(Si = sum(Si), Fe = sum(Fe), Cu = sum(Cu), Mn = sum(Mn), Mg = sum(Mg), Cr = sum(Cr), Ni = sum(Ni), Zn = sum(Zn),
                                                                             Ti = sum(Ti), Ga = sum(Ga), V = sum(V),  otherOrUndefinedElements = sum(otherOrUndefinedElements), otherOrUndefinedElements_ = sum(otherOrUndefinedElements_),
                                                                             Al = sum(Al))
materialAl_5xxxcompositionMax <- materialAl_5xxxcompositionMaximas %>% summarise(Si = max(Si), Fe = max(Fe), Cu = max(Cu), Mn = max(Mn), Mg = max(Mg), Cr = max(Cr), Ni = max(Ni), Zn = max(Zn),
                                                                                 Ti = max(Ti), Ga = max(Ga), V = max(V),  otherOrUndefinedElements = max(otherOrUndefinedElements), otherOrUndefinedElements_ = max(otherOrUndefinedElements_),
                                                                                 Al = max(Al))
materialAl_5xxxcompositionMin <- materialAl_5xxxcompositionMaximas %>% summarise(Si = min(Si), Fe = min(Fe), Cu = min(Cu), Mn = min(Mn), Mg = min(Mg), Cr = min(Cr), Ni = min(Ni), Zn = min(Zn),
                                                                                 Ti = min(Ti), Ga = min(Ga), V = min(V),  otherOrUndefinedElements = min(otherOrUndefinedElements), otherOrUndefinedElements_ = min(otherOrUndefinedElements_), Al = min(Al))

# Should the Min and Max be changed for the main Element Aluminium
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
materialAl_5xxxcompositionSum <- materialAl_5xxxcompositionSum %>% add_column(limits = "mean")
materialAl_5xxxcompositionMax <- materialAl_5xxxcompositionMax %>% add_column(limits = "max")
materialAl_5xxxcompositionMin <- materialAl_5xxxcompositionMin %>% add_column(limits = "min")

materialAl_5xxxcomposition <- bind_rows(materialAl_5xxxcompositionSum, materialAl_5xxxcompositionMax)
materialAl_5xxxcomposition <- bind_rows(materialAl_5xxxcomposition, materialAl_5xxxcompositionMin)
materialAl_5xxxcomposition

#Display the material composition based on the mean, max and min values
materialAl_5xxxcomposition_long <- materialAl_5xxxcomposition %>% pivot_longer(cols = !c(limits), names_to = "Element", values_to = "Content")

# Step 1: Extract rows where 'column_name' is 0
zero_entries_df <- materialAl_5xxxcomposition_long %>% filter(Content == 0 & limits == "mean")
zero_entries_df

# Step 2: Filter out these entries from the original dataframe
materialAl_5xxxcomposition_long <- materialAl_5xxxcomposition_long %>% filter(!(materialAl_5xxxcomposition_long$Element) %in% (zero_entries_df$Element))

materialAl_5xxxcomposition <- materialAl_5xxxcomposition_long
materialAl_5xxxcomposition

materialAl_5xxxcomposition_long <- materialAl_5xxxcomposition_long %>%
  mutate(
    Element = ifelse(Element == "otherOrUndefinedElements", "other1", Element),  # Replace "elvHEV" with "HEV"
    Element = ifelse(Element == "otherOrUndefinedElements_", "other2", Element)
  )


g <- ggplot(materialAl_5xxxcomposition_long, mapping = aes(x = Element, y = Content)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle("Material composition - Al5xxx Aluminium") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,100), name = "content (%)") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

plot(g)

g <- ggplot(materialAl_5xxxcomposition_long, mapping = aes(x = Element, y = Content)) +
      geom_boxplot() +

plot(g)
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  temp_sum <- temp_mean %>% select(!c(Numerisch, limits)) %>% mutate(Si = Si * Al_7xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Fe = Fe * Al_7xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Cu = Cu * Al_7xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                                Mn = Mn * Al_7xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Mg = Mg * Al_7xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Cr = Cr * Al_7xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                                Ni = Ni * Al_7xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Zn = Zn * Al_7xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Ti = Ti * Al_7xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                                Ga = Ga * Al_7xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], V = V * Al_7xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], otherOrUndefinedElements = otherOrUndefinedElements * Al_7xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                                otherOrUndefinedElements_ = otherOrUndefinedElements_ * Al_7xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Al = Al * Al_7xxxAlDefinition$Fraction[i]
                                                                )
 
  if (i == 1) {
    materialAl_7xxxcompositionSum <- temp_sum
    materialAl_7xxxcompositionMaximas <- temp
  }
  else {
    materialAl_7xxxcompositionSum <- bind_rows(materialAl_7xxxcompositionSum, temp_sum)
    materialAl_7xxxcompositionMaximas <- bind_rows(materialAl_7xxxcompositionMaximas, temp)
  }
}
```
